source.title: Some new and old (unsolved) problems and conjectures on factorization theory, dynamics and functional equations of meromorphic functions

trace.notes: Input normalized as zbMATH resolver URL https://zbmath.org/6831143. Direct fetch of the zbMATH page returned HTTP 403 with a Cloudflare challenge, so identifier-specific recovery was used.

zbMATH API document 6831143 identified the exact work: Liao, Liangwen and Yang, Chungchun, DOI 10.16357/j.cnki.issn1000-5862.2017.03.06, Journal of Jiangxi Normal University. Natural Science Edition 41(3), pages 242-247 (2017). API metadata was used only for identity and title recovery, not for extraction.

The DOI resolved through chndoi to CNKI links for the same DOI. The CNKI overseas landing page exposed title, authors, abstract, keywords, table of contents, DOI, and article metadata, but not the full article text or problem statements.

CNKI PDF, original reading, HTML reading, and English HTML reading endpoints for filename CAPE201703023 redirected to a login page or an error page rather than readable full text. Failure mode classified as paywalled_or_restricted with blocked_or_challenged access to downloadable/readable artifacts.

Exact-work recovery searches by exact English title, exact Chinese title, DOI, and CNKI identifier CAPE201703023 did not recover a readable PDF or full HTML source for the same work. Candidate pages were metadata-only records, citation references in other papers, login-gated CNKI pages, or different works.
No document map was produced because no readable full-text PDF or HTML artifact containing the problem statements was recovered.
Saved final JSON to outputs/parse-paper/6831143.json and outputs/latest.json.
